context: See Warnings and Precautions (5.4, 5.6).] 3 DOSAGE FORMS AND STRENGTHS Disposable teal green device with 60 blisters containing salmeterol (50 mcg) as an oral inhalation powder formulation. An institutional pack containing 28 blisters is also available.
RENGTHS Inhalation powder: Inhaler containing a foil blister strip of powder formulation for oral inhalation. The strip contains salmeterol 50 mcg per blister.
